title: Let's go here: South Florida weekend spots
igCaption:
Send this to who you're going with 👀 Let's go here this weekend

Oleta River: Florida's biggest urban park, kayaks + bike trails
Cape Florida: beach day + Miami's oldest lighthouse (1825)
Domino Park: cafecito and dominoes on Calle Ocho
Deering Estate: historic estate right on Biscayne Bay

Which one first? Tag who you're taking.

#Miami #MiamiThingsToDo #SouthFlorida #MiamiWeekend

scenes.text: Send this to the person you're going with this weekend. Let's go here.
scenes.caption: Send this to the person you're going with this weekend. Let's go here.

scenes.text: First, Oleta River State Park, in North Miami Beach. It's the largest urban park in Florida. Rent a kayak and paddle the river, or hit the mountain bike trails.
scenes.caption: First, Oleta River State Park, in North Miami Beach. It's the largest urban park in Florida. Rent a kayak and paddle the river, or hit the mountain bike trails.

scenes.text: Next, Bill Baggs Cape Florida, at the tip of Key Biscayne. Spend a beach day, then walk to the lighthouse. It was first built in 1825. It's the oldest standing structure in Miami.
scenes.caption: Next, Bill Baggs Cape Florida, at the tip of Key Biscayne. Spend a beach day, then walk to the lighthouse. It was first built in 1825. It's the oldest standing structure in Miami.

scenes.text: Then Domino Park, on Calle Ocho in Little Havana. Locals have played dominoes here for decades. Grab a cafecito and watch a game.
scenes.caption: Then Domino Park, on Calle Ocho in Little Havana. Locals have played dominoes here for decades. Grab a cafecito and watch a game.

scenes.text: And the Deering Estate, in Palmetto Bay. Historic houses, nature trails, and a view straight across Biscayne Bay. Stay for the sunset.
scenes.caption: And the Deering Estate, in Palmetto Bay. Historic houses, nature trails, and a view straight across Biscayne Bay. Stay for the sunset.
